artifact_review:
The Router identified two key artifacts: a texture anomaly on the meatloaf surface and structural collapse on the foil pan rim. 
1. Texture Anomaly (Right-center): The Router assigned severity 1.5. This is a reasonable assessment. The pale yellow patch looks like a generation error where the glaze texture failed to render or was 'wiped' away, revealing a flat, pasty underlying texture. It breaks the visual consistency of the food item.
2. Structural Collapse (Left Pan Rim): The Router assigned severity 2.0. This is also accurate. The foil pan's edge dissolves into the background shadow without a clear geometric boundary, a common AI struggle with thin, reflective metallic objects. 
The Perceptual Quality Auditor found no global distortions (noise/blur), which supports the idea that these are localized structural/textural failures rather than overall image degradation. The Topology Auditor confirmed a strong mask, meaning the object is coherent, but this doesn't rule out the surface texture issues.
alignment_reasoning: The image strongly aligns with the 'meat loaf' class. The fine-grained classifier confirmed the label with high confidence (logit 7.46). The geometry, color, and context (foil pan) are all correct. The only deduction is minor: the surface texture inconsistency (the pale patch) makes it a slightly imperfect representation of a 'glossy glazed' loaf, but it is undeniably a meatloaf.
artifact_reasoning: The image suffers from two distinct local artifacts. The pale, non-glossy smudge on the right side of the loaf disrupts the material realism (severity ~1.5-2.0). The melting/disappearing edge of the aluminum pan on the left is a clear structural/geometric failure (severity ~2.0). These prevent the image from achieving a perfect artifact score, but they do not ruin the overall recognizability. The rest of the image is clean.
